hook_text: Phone asleep. Then the big one bit.

song.title: Heave Ho, Let It Sleep
song.style: English, rousing sea shanty with accordion, fiddle, stomping boots, hand claps and a gang chorus, warm friendly male lead vocal, hearty, 116 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Out on the pier with my rod
Phone in my hand, head down, nod
A fish took the bait and was gone
I missed it, I scrolled right on

[Chorus]
Heave ho, let it sleep
Eyes on the water deep
Heave ho, hold the line
The big one will be mine

[Verse]
I slid my phone in its sleeve
And watched the waves and believed
The line went tight, the rod bent low
A fish as big as a boat below

[Chorus]
Heave ho, let it go
Back to the deep below
Heave ho, hold the line
I've got the sea and time

shots.prompt: A giant silver fish leaps out of the sea in a burst of spray right behind {moss}, who sits on a wooden pier staring at a glowing phone and never notices. Low angle, the camera whips up with the fish. Bright morning sun.
Extreme close-up of a red and white fishing float bobbing on green water. The camera pushes in. Bright morning sun.
{moss} sits on the edge of a wooden pier, a fishing rod propped in one hand and a buzzing phone in the other, head down. The camera orbits fast around him. Bright morning sun.
A phone buzzes and jumps in the hand of {moss} and he fumbles it. Close-up, the camera crash zooms in. Bright morning sun.
A red and white float plunges underwater and a fishing rod tip jerks hard. Low angle, the camera pushes in fast. Bright morning sun.
A bare fishing hook pops up out of the water, the bait gone. Close-up, the camera tilts up with it. Bright morning sun.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, disappointed, holding up an empty fishing hook. The camera pushes in. Bright morning sun.

An old fisherwoman in a yellow sou'wester hat and a thick blue knit sweater with a long white braid shakes her head at the camera from her little wooden rowboat. The camera whip pans to her. Bright morning sun.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, sea wind blowing in his face, waves spraying behind him. The camera cranes up. Bright sun, sparkling sea.
An old fisherwoman in a yellow sou'wester hat and a thick blue knit sweater with a long white braid hauls a huge silver fish into her rowboat, laughing. The camera whip pans to her. Bright sun.
{moss} leans over the edge of the pier peering down into clear green water. Top-down, the camera pushes in. Bright sun.
A huge dark fish shadow glides slowly under the water beneath a wooden pier. The camera cranes down toward it. Bright sun on green water.
{moss} stands up on the pier, sea wind flapping his raincoat, looking determined. The camera dolly zooms. Bright sun.
A white seagull lands right on top of the green beanie of {moss}. Close-up, the camera crash zooms in. Bright sun.
{moss} points out to sea like a ship's captain. Low angle, the camera cranes up. Bright sun, sparkling sea.
{moss} pulls a buzzing phone out of his raincoat pocket and looks from it to the sea. The camera pushes in. Bright sun.

A slim terracotta-orange sleeve stands upright on a soft pale green backdrop, a phone tucked inside so only its top edge peeks out, the sleeve's top edge cut like a closed eyelid with black lashes. Soft leaf shadows drift across the backdrop. Warm daylight. The camera slowly pushes in as the light turns warmer.
{moss} tucks a terracotta-orange sleeve into his raincoat pocket and pats it. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright sun.
{moss} sits cross-legged on the pier, calm, both hands on his fishing rod, watching the waves. The camera orbits fast around him. Golden morning light.
Sunlight sparkles on rolling green waves. FPV, the camera skims low over the water. Golden morning light.
The fishing rod bends almost in half and {moss} is yanked to his feet, his boots skidding on the planks. The camera crash zooms in. Bright sun.
A fishing reel spins wildly, the line whizzing out. Extreme close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright sun.
A giant silver fish as big as a rowboat leaps out of the sea right in front of {moss}, spray flying everywhere. Low angle, the camera rises with the fish. Bright sun.
Extreme close-up: the glasses of {moss} are dripping with sea spray, his mouth wide open under his mustache. The camera crash zooms in. Bright sun.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, soaking wet and laughing, gripping his fishing rod. The camera pushes in. Bright sun.
A giant friendly fish eye at the water's surface winks at the camera. Extreme close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright sun on green water.
{moss} gently unhooks the giant silver fish and it slides back into the sea with a big splash. The camera cranes up. Golden light.
A giant silver fish tail flicks out of the water and splashes {moss}. Low angle, the camera whips with the splash. Golden light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, rowing a little wooden rowboat beside an old fisherwoman in a yellow sou'wester hat and a thick blue knit sweater with a long white braid. The camera orbits around the boat. Golden afternoon light.

An old fisherwoman in a yellow sou'wester hat and a thick blue knit sweater with a long white braid hands {moss} a steaming cup of tea from a thermos in the rowboat. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Golden afternoon light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, on the pier at sunset, a warm lantern glowing beside him. The camera slowly pulls back. Warm sunset light.

{moss} and an old fisherwoman in a yellow sou'wester hat and a thick blue knit sweater with a long white braid sit on the end of the pier at sunset, legs dangling, a lantern glowing between them over a calm sea. The camera slowly drifts up. Warm golden glow.

caption: moss kept missing every bite while checking his phone. Eyelid on, eyes on the water, and the big one finally showed up
